ValidationRule.description: Prevent Using the Duplicate Contact while creating the Interaction Records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( INCLUDES(Broker__r.Sync_Status__c ,'Duplicate - Email'), INCLUDES(Broker__r.Sync_Status__c ,'Duplicate - OCV Id') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Duplicate Broker is Selected, please add another contact
